image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a tiger beetle (likely genus Tricondyla or similar) perched on a green leaf. The beetle has a distinctively elongated, segmented body with a metallic dark green/bronze sheen and fine punctate texture on the elytra. It features long, slender orange-red legs and very long, thin filiform antennae. The head is narrow with prominent compound eyes and visible mandibles. The background is a soft-focus bright green.
